OBSERVED_BEHAVIOUR.correlation: failure only in the slow, fully loaded full-suite runs

CHARACTERISATION_BEFORE_FIX.method: reconstructed the test body verbatim and ran it 6 times against a fresh temp store
CHARACTERISATION_BEFORE_FIX.conclusion: the barrier broke; the ledger never misbehaved

ROOT_CAUSE: threading.Barrier(20) released in five waves across 100 tasks on a 20-worker pool. barrier.wait(timeout=5) on a loaded machine trips once, and a tripped Barrier is broken for every subsequent wave, so 80 of the remaining workers fail before reaching put_vote at all.
FIX: threading.Event start gate + explicit pool.submit, releasing all 20 concurrent workers simultaneously. Same contention, no wave structure, nothing to break.
